messages:
rachel: Borealis wants a quick perf validation before EOC sign. Goal: sustain 800 rps steady, support 2k bursts for 3-5m, avg output ~180 tokens, p95 target <=500ms. Also asked for a Dedicated cost option and KMS notes.
dan: Confirm prompt size and single-turn? Hosted preferred?
rachel: Single-turn, prompt ~150 tokens. Hosted ok but they asked for a Dedicated baseline. Call Wed.
mitch: I'll run a compact bench. Plan: warm 5m -> 400rps, step to 800, short spike 2k for 5m, sustain 15m at 800. Test models: 13B-q4, 34B-q4. Batches [8,12], kv_cache off.
infra-bot: perf-job queued (cluster=perf-mini, workers=32), job_id=perf-3861, eta=2m
ops: curl example for smoke:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"13B-q4","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":180,"batch_size":8}'
```
mitch: Quick smoke results: 13B-q4 batch=12: p50=140ms p95=640ms p99=980ms errs=1.1% (timeouts at 2k spike).
helen: Try batch=8 and 34B-q4?
mitch: Rerun 13B-q4 batch=8: p50=200ms p95=470ms p99=750ms errs=0.2% sustained 15m at 800. 34B-q4 batch=8: p50=190ms p95=420ms p99=690ms errs=0.3% (fewer GPUs but more mem).
dan: Cost sketch: hosted ~ $14k/mo for steady 800rps (avg 180 tokens) ; Dedicated reserved fleet estimate ~$9k/mo infra + platform -> quote ~$11k/mo with SLA. Need final pricing calc.
rachel: Security: KMS/CMEK supported; provide SOC2 and KMS checklist before Wed. ops please share docs.
ops: SOC2 link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2.pdf . KMS checklist: support for AWS KMS/GCP KMS, rotation testing required, will coordinate.
mitch: Artifacts uploaded to perf/3861234567/ (plots + logs). I'll add grafana snapshots to the invite.
helen: Sales next steps: 1) one-slide perf summary (mitch) 2) Dedicated sizing + preliminary quote (dan) 3) security docs (ops) 4) present Wed call.
rachel: Thanks team — please drop deliverables by Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
